candidate.title: Stale calendar credential reused across references in updateAllCalendarEvents loop
reports: stale credential variable reused across loop iterations in updateallcalendarevents: credential declared outside the loop keeps the previous iteration's value when a reference.credentialid cannot be resolved, potentially updating an event on the wrong user's calendar with wrong auth (packages/core/eventmanager.ts:~495-530)

stale credential leaks across the reference loop in eventmanager.update: credential is declared once outside the for (const reference of calendarreference) loop but only conditionally assigned inside it, so if a later reference's credential is not in calendarcredentials and the db fetch returns null, the previous iteration's credential is retained and updateevent runs with the wrong host's credential, throwing and marking all references failed or updating through an unrelated credential.

in updateallcalendarevents (packages/core/eventmanager.ts ~493-520), the credential variable is declared outside the for (const reference of calendarreference) loop and retains the previous reference's credential when a reference's credentialid resolves to a deleted credential — host b's update runs with host a's calendar credential (wrong calendar or 404/403); on the first iteration credential is undefined and updateevent(undefined, ...) throws into the outer catch, which returns all references as failed while already-launched update promises keep running, causing partial state divergence.
